decisionFactor: Routine recurring care within LOC package
trigger: ADL/toileting/mobility/monitoring can be safely delivered through shared staffing included in resident's final LOC
locEffect: Increase LOC if overall recurring complexity warrants
reviewSafeguard: Do not charge PCG for care already represented in LOC

trigger: Resident requires continuous or near-continuous individual observation for safety
locEffect: LOC may also rise if supervision reflects overall complexity
pcgEffect: PCG may be required for defined hours
requiredDocumentation: Trigger, duration, incidents, alternatives attempted, why shared staffing is insufficient
reviewSafeguard: Set review date; reassess after change

trigger: Resident requires one staff member dedicated for prolonged periods beyond normal episodic LOC care
locEffect: LOC reflects dependency; avoid duplicate charging
pcgEffect: PCG may be required for 8/12/24h according to actual dedicated staffing need
reviewSafeguard: Document which services are already included in LOC

trigger: Repeated unsafe nighttime mobility/toileting/wandering requires dedicated overnight observation/assistance
pcgEffect: Night PCG if shared night staffing cannot safely meet need
reviewSafeguard: Review at least after material change and periodically

trigger: Short-term decline requires dedicated assistance exceeding baseline package
locEffect: Reassess LOC; avoid permanent increase for clearly transient need unless sustained
requiredDocumentation: Start date, reason, expected duration, exit criteria

trigger: Frequent unsafe behavior, wandering, agitation or inability to remain safe without individual supervision
locEffect: May increase LOC via cognition/supervision rules
pcgEffect: PCG if dedicated individual staffing is still required beyond final LOC package

trigger: Family requests individual companion/support without assessed clinical/operational necessity

decisionFactor: High care needs but shared staffing remains sufficient
trigger: Resident is L3/L4 yet tasks can be safely delivered within approved staffing model
pcgEffect: No PCG solely because resident is high LOC
reviewSafeguard: Prevents automatic PCG assignment by level

decisionFactor: Private caregiver currently masks resident dependency
trigger: PCG performs ADLs/supervision that resident intrinsically requires
locEffect: Assess LOC from resident need regardless of who performs it
pcgEffect: PCG decision made separately after final LOC
reviewSafeguard: Do not score resident as more independent because PCG performs care

trigger: Required clinical/safety care remains beyond approved scope/capability even with dedicated staffing
locEffect: LOC classification alone does not solve capability issue
pcgEffect: PCG must not be used to substitute for required higher-acuity service

trigger: LifeCare requires PCG as condition of safe continued care
locEffect: No duplicate LOC charge for same staffing rationale
pcgEffect: PCG fee permitted only for documented incremental dedicated staffing
requiredDocumentation: Trigger → intervention → frequency/duration → shared-staffing insufficiency → alternatives → review date

trigger: Dedicated staffing need decreases or can now be safely absorbed within LOC package
reviewSafeguard: No indefinite PCG without current justification
